label: B25-QUARTUS-PHYSICAL
title: Run fresh 25 MHz synthesis, fitter and signoff STA
scope: Build an exact fresh B25 source/MIF/QSF/SDC manifest and run only synthesis, fitter, signoff STA and nonfatal clock/BRAM/CDC reports at the real 25 MHz logic clock.
launch_preconditions: T-037 final candidate includes the completed T-045 EMIF resilience lane and is pushed to origin.
The exact candidate rebuilds boot.bin/boot.hex/boot.mif and passes check_skeleton.py --require-boot-image.
GamePC and the remote probe are acquired through resource-lock; no Quartus/JTAG owner is active.

physical_input_contract.tracked_sources: checkout/fresh-copy the exact candidate SHA; record a canonical candidate-relative manifest and verify it after transfer
physical_input_contract.generated_mif: explicitly copy the candidate-generated fpga/catapult_a10/boot/build/boot.mif to the QSF-relative remote boot/build path; do not assume Git carries ignored build output
physical_input_contract.mif_evidence: record boot ELF/BIN/HEX/MIF hashes and bytes, WIDTH=64, DEPTH=8192, 8192 records, generator hash, QSF assignment and remote post-copy hash
physical_input_contract.closure: run check_platform.py and check_skeleton.py --require-boot-image before launch; physical source manifest must include the generated MIF as tracked=false/generated=true (at least 53 entries if no other inputs are added)
physical_input_contract.stale_database_guard: use a new task-local remote output root and reject any pre-existing Quartus database or Loading-final-database reuse

validation: Confirm MIF is consumed, sys_clk_25 is exactly 40 ns, Qsys/clk_y3 clocks remain valid, setup/hold/recovery/removal/min-pulse are nonnegative, DDR/metastability reports pass, and resources fit.
acceptance: All allowed physical stages pass on the exact T-037 candidate and a frozen fit/STA database is safe to hand to separately authorized assembler task T-043.
resource: Every remote stage acquires gamepc; >=16 GiB admission, free<14 GiB safety-stop, one Quartus process and fresh output root.
forbidden_regions: RTL/QEMU/QSF/SDC semantic fixes during the run

superseded_by.status: fresh synthesis/fitter/STA and v2 invariant physical signoff PASS
